name: @cfdi-risk-auditor/catalog-watcher
description: Phase 6 Catalog Watcher: monthly scheduled job that detects new SAT ground-truth publications (catalogs.db releases, XSD tree, Anexo 20 PDF, 69-B CSV), diffs them deterministically against the pinned versions in corpus/sources.json, optionally narrates the diff via an LLM under a deterministic grounding check, and opens a PR. Never merges; a human does.
